# p0_ai_gateway_log_provider_link (Resource)

Links an installed AI gateway to a log provider, so P0 can show the gateway's MCP tool-call
activity in the Event Log.

This resource manages only the gateway's log provider. When you destroy the link, P0 unlinks the gateway. Use one
link for each gateway. Two links to the same gateway overwrite each other on each apply.

P0 checks that it can reach the gateway through its management tunnel each time the link changes. So the gateway
must be running when you create, change or destroy this resource.

If the gateway is already gone, or P0 cannot reach it, destroy fails. To remove the link from
state without an unlink, run `terraform state rm p0_ai_gateway_log_provider_link.<name>`.

When a gateway has no log provider, P0 reads its activity from the `log_project_id` on
`p0_ai_gateway`, if it has one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# See the p0_ai_gateway example for the gateway install.
#
# P0 checks that it can reach a gateway each time its link changes, so the
# gateway must be running. Each gateway has one link.

# A gateway that reads activity from the VictoriaLogs instance next to it.
resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider" "victorialogs" {
  id   = "victorialogs"
  type = "victorialogs"
}

resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider_link" "example" {
  gateway      = p0_ai_gateway.example.id
  log_provider = p0_ai_gateway_log_provider.victorialogs.id
}

# A second gateway whose logs go to Google Cloud Logging. project_id is the
# project that holds the log bucket.
resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider" "gcp" {
  id         = "gcp-logs"
  type       = "gcp"
  project_id = "my-gcp-logging-project"
}

resource "p0_ai_gateway_log_provider_link" "gcp_example" {
  gateway      = p0_ai_gateway.gcp_example.id
  log_provider = p0_ai_gateway_log_provider.gcp.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway` (String) The `id` of the installed `p0_ai_gateway` to link
- `log_provider` (String) The `id` of the `p0_ai_gateway_log_provider` that holds the gateway's activity logs

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `id` of the gateway
